children: FG Nexus entered into a Subscription Agreement with FG Communities to purchase 1,818,182 common shares for $10,000,001, or $5.50 per share. The investment closed on September 21, 2026, and provides exposure to a growing portfolio of manufactured housing communities. Given overlapping leadership between the companies, the deal was reviewed by a special committee of independent directors and an independent financial advisor before board approval.
